subject.title: feat: add disposable Vercel and Convex PR previews

question: Should this PR land before the Preview-targeted production/auth/OpenAI environment-variable cleanup and hosted preview proof are confirmed?
rationale: The remaining risk is account-level Vercel/Convex configuration and secret targeting, which source inspection and automated code repair cannot verify safely.

options.title: Require cleanup and hosted proof first
options.body: Confirm Preview-only secrets, remove shared production/auth/OpenAI variables from Preview targeting, and attach hosted preview proof before merge.

options.title: Accept the temporary operator risk
options.body: Merge with the documented follow-up and let operators own any temporary Preview exposure from shared env variables.

options.title: Pause the preview rollout
options.body: Hold or narrow the PR until the external Vercel environment model can be made clean without a manual follow-up.

recommendation.title: Require cleanup and hosted proof first
recommendation.body: Confirm Preview-only secrets, remove shared production/auth/OpenAI variables from Preview targeting, and attach hosted preview proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is both the current PR author and the strongest history owner for the deployment/runtime surfaces being changed.
